facts.fact: Benin's Treasury (DGTCP) says its Centre d'Ecoute Clients has been in a pilot phase since July 2024, taking complaints by phone, email, web form and a physical counter, with the IT complaints-management system still in production and to be deployed soon.
facts.system: Centre d'Ecoute Clients (CEC) du Tresor public

systems.platform: multichannel: phone, email, web form, counter
systems.owner: Direction Generale du Tresor et de la Comptabilite Publique
